historical_record.description: A two-storey building with five off-street parking spaces stood on the lot, used as a veterinary clinic (animal hospital) under a conditional use. The City Planning Commission disapproved modifying the conditions of Resolution No. 6172 to allow a 2,015-square-foot expansion of the animal hospital.
